card.name: Subject noun right before "should"
card.fires_on: The last word of a subject phrase (a test, sample, lab value or drug) in instructional label text, where a verb like "should" or "is best" is expected next.

modes.label: Lab tests and samples
modes.description: End of a subject naming a test, sample or lab value, before "should be drawn/measured/monitored".
modes.example: Blood samples for serum lithium determin<<ations>> should be drawn immediately prior to the next

modes.label: Other subjects awaiting a verb
modes.description: A noun or pronoun ending a clause where "should be given/planted" or similar follows.
modes.example: If these products are needed,<< they>> should be given at least 2 hours

card.writes: It raises "should" and "recommended" (also the Chinese words for "suggest" and "recommend"), predicting an advice verb next.
card.plain: It fires on the subject of a sentence just before the label says what "should" be done with it.
